text.description_html:
Brass Accents D04-K3225/D07-C3601/CYLHOLE, Fleur De Lis Plate with Netropol Knob and Cylinder Hole

This gorgeous Dummy Plate features the popular Fleur de Lis design at both ends, as well as patterned edges with incredible detail. The Fleur De Lis Dummy Plate with Netropol Knob and Cylinder Cut-Out is custom made.

Features and Specifications of the Single Cylinder Fleur De Lis Dummy Plate:

  • Material: Solid Cast Brass
  • Interior and Exterior Plate Width: 3"
  • Interior and Exterior Plate Height: 18"
  • Center of Plate to Center of Cylinder Hole: 2"
  • Center of Cylinder Hole to Center of Knob: 4"
  • Cylinder hole sized for mortise cylinder.

Special order item. No Returns
